__comment: OAuth2 replaces the dead username/password validator. customUI hosts the consent webview (like com.palm.eas / com.palm.skype); it loads OAuth2.buildAuthorizeUrl(), captures ?code= from the redirect to Config.REDIRECT_URI, then calls exchangeCode which returns the stored token credentials.
__comment2: com.palm.app.cloud-auth MUST be in write/readPermissions: createAccount runs under the customUI auth app's identity and is permission-checked against these lists (accounts/handlers/create.js -> Utils.hasPermission). Working templates (teams/telegram/skype) list their own auth app, not com.palm.app.accounts.
__comment3: com.palm.service.onedrive is in read+writePermissions so the service itself can readCredentials(accountId) for file ops and writeCredentials back after a token refresh - Microsoft ROTATES the refresh token on every use, so the write path runs on nearly every call (accounts/handlers/credentials.js checks these lists).

capabilityProviders.__comment: No longer bound to QuickOffice (closed/dead). The file-picker app and the QuickOffice reroute consume listFolder/downloadFile.

Makes the OneDrive account a photo source. implementation/hooks point at the stock Photos AGGREGATOR (com.palm.service.photos), which discovers PHOTO.UPLOAD accounts and (via templateId->serviceName in its Utils.js) calls com.palm.service.onedrive/listAlbums+listPhotos, then downloads bytes with the curl-patched Sync-Manager. src_big is each item's @microsoft.graph.downloadUrl (pre-signed; the curl -L fetch needs no auth header).
